facts.text: Embry-Riddle Worldwide allows students to pursue degrees online or across more than 110 global physical locations.

sources.title: Worldwide & Online Campus - Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University
sources.quote: At Embry‑Riddle's Worldwide & Online Campus, you can study online or at 110+ global locations while preparing to advance your career through faculty mentorship, research and real-world opportunities.
